common_name: Autumn Magic Aronia (Compact Ornamental Black Chokeberry)

planting.note: Plant container or bare-root shrubs in spring in moist, well-drained to wet soil in full sun to partial shade; Autumn Magic is a compact black chokeberry selection bred as much for landscape use and fall color as for its edible fruit.

directions: Plant in moist, well-drained to wet soil in full sun to partial shade; Autumn Magic is a compact black chokeberry cultivar selected primarily for landscape use, staying notably smaller and more rounded than seed-grown Aronia melanocarpa while still producing a good crop of glossy black, antioxidant-rich berries. The shrub is a genuine multi-season landscape plant: clusters of white flowers in spring, clean dark green summer foliage, and some of the most vivid red-purple fall color of any Aronia selection, making it a strong choice for a foundation planting or mixed border that also happens to produce useful fruit. Berries are highly astringent eaten raw and are best processed into juice, syrup, or dried additions to baked goods and trail mixes. The self-fertile, adaptable shrub tolerates wet or dry soils and both full sun and considerable shade, and needs only occasional renewal pruning of the oldest stems to stay dense and well-shaped.
